@graph.name: Taroko Gorge Ecosystem Archive
@graph.description: Public metadata of a research archive of Nick Montfort's Taroko Gorge (2009) and its remixes: 61 candidate URLs, 61 fetch attempts (55 downloaded pages), a keyword-heuristic inventory, a summary of word-list sizes and hashes, and a log of runtime sampling, plus the pipeline scripts and working notes. Raw captured pages, screenshots, runtime text and full word arrays are not part of this public dataset because they reproduce third-party works. Source code is the primary archival object for generative works.

mentions.description: Generative JavaScript poetry by Nick Montfort. The archived works are Taroko Gorge and remix works derived from it.
